title: typhalea fruticosa
intro: Typhalea fruticosa, commonly known as 'Wild Yam', is a plant species native to North America. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in alleviating menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and other gynecological issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Typhalea fruticosa include its ability to relax muscles, reduce pain, and regulate hormonal imbalances. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a steroid saponin with estrogenic properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
